Former covert CIA officer Andrew Bustamante speaks freely with Danny Jones in this visit. Bustamante served seven years in the agency and fought as an Air Force veteran. He now teaches spy craft to the public.

Jones gives him room to tell tales from years spent in disguise. Bustamante explains how officers gather facts while living a cover life. He shares lessons on reading people and staying calm under watch. The episode is a broad, uncensored tour of an operative's world, from recruit training to life after the agency. Every tale comes with a lesson attached.

Noland Arbaugh, the first person to receive a Neuralink brain implant, talks with Joe Rogan in episode 2167. Arbaugh was paralyzed in a diving accident before joining Elon Musk's brain-chip trial. The device lets him move a computer cursor with thought alone.

Arbaugh describes daily life with the chip, from playing games to the surgery and its setbacks. He explains what it feels like when thought becomes action on a screen. Rogan asks about the future of the tech for both healing and enhancement. Future-minded listeners hear the first human account of living with a brain implant.
